description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.42 (opi-q5k.10 / markdown.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream describe 'Links' (7 tests). Port: no URL duplication for autolinked emails, no URL duplication for bare URLs, shows URL in parentheses when hyperlinks not supported (regular + mailto), emits OSC 8 when terminal supports hyperlinks (regular + mailto + bare URL), works with file:// URIs. Soft-depends on opi-q5k.34 (terminal capability detection).

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/markdown.test.ts; locate the "Links" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/markdown_test.exs.
4. Implement missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Markdown.
5. Port missing tests.
6. Re-read upstream "Links" top-to-bottom; confirm mapping.
7. Post a final mapping comment.
8. Close.

Upstream uses VirtualTerminal + Chalk for rendering assertions and relies on defaultMarkdownTheme fixture. Elixir equivalent: our Theme module (OctoPi.TUI.Theme.load_builtin(:dark, :truecolor)) + WrapAnsi helpers for strip/visible-width.

## Deps
Parent opi-q5k.42 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).

comments.text: Partial — 3 of 7 upstream tests ported. Covers the unsupported-hyperlinks path (URL-in-parens, no duplication, file://). OSC 8 + autolink deferred until a real use case justifies threading hyperlinks? through Markdown.
